contract: MP4 or MOV open (Mp4Open) and index (Mp4IndexJob) in the native MOV view through the playback engine; the reference uses the mov demuxer without parsers or timestamp fill-in
regular inputs seekable through Engine::mp4; progressive front-moov inputs forward-only through the native front plan and Engine::mp4_native_terminal_v1, continuing through later moof/mdat pairs
every track selected; every packet through a clean end of file in native read order
each packet folded with track ID, PTS, DTS and duration in the track time base, packet flags, size and every payload byte
the expected fold is recorded per case from the pinned reference worker
